findings: OTP code breaks in Outlook — The OTP display uses inline-block divs, which Outlook doesn't support. Convert to nested tables with inline styles.
HTML duplicated in TypeScript — lib/email-templates.ts hardcodes full HTML instead of reading from emails/ directory. Refactor to read from filesystem and cache.
Missing TypeScript validation — EmailTemplate interface accepts any string values. replaceVariables() doesn't escape HTML entities, creating XSS risk. Add validation and HTML escaping.

Avatar initial in div, not table — proposal-received.html uses {{CREATOR_AVATAR_INITIAL}} in a div with inline-block styling instead of table cells, risking layout breaks in Outlook and with multi-byte characters.
Media queries stripped — Embedded style in head is stripped by Gmail and others. Mobile layout degrades. Accept as limitation or inline conditional styles.
Plain-text fallbacks unusable — htmlToText() strips all tags and collapses whitespace. OTP code is buried, password reset links are missing URLs. Write template-specific plain-text versions.
Test endpoint exposed — /api/test-emails route ships with no auth. Add NODE_ENV check or middleware.
